sentences.text: Shri Prabal Singh Rajput - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Sourabh Soni - Panel Lawyer for the State.
 Order

This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C./Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 17/2025 dated 22.4.2025 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana, District Dindori for the offences punishable under Sections 376 & 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code.
2. The counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
As per the statement of the prosecutrix, their relationship was consensual.
The applicant and the prosecutrix were known to each other since July, 2020.
The prosecutrix was major and subsequently with an oblique motive, the report in question was lodged.
It is submitted that the applicant is in custody since 22.4.2025 and is not required for further custodial interrogation.
Trial will take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be released on bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:25357 2 MCRC-19227-2025 3.
Per contra, counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that there is direct allegation against the applicant.
Therefore, no case for bail is made out.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.

5. Considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 183 of the BNSS, nature of allegation against the applicant and the period of his custody, this Court deems it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
7. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
